description.value: Hungry Eats is a family-owned American diner in Surrey serving a broad comfort-food menu of burgers, fish & chips, salads, wraps, and starters. The restaurant emphasizes fresh ingredients and offers both dine-in table reservations and online ordering for takeout. Touring cyclists will find a filling, varied menu including several vegetarian options.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Hungry Eats is a real, active family-owned diner in Surrey with online ordering ('Online Order' buttons throughout), a full menu, and a reservation system. OSM tags internet_access=no and outdoor_seating=no are consistent with the website, which mentions neither Wi-Fi nor a patio. Vegetarian items are confirmed by the menu (Veggie Power Bowl, Veggie Burger, Cauliflower Wings); takeout is confirmed by prominent Online Order calls-to-action. No evidence for bike-specific amenities, washrooms, or water refill on either the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM community field is 'North Vancouver' but both the OSM address and website clearly place the business in Surrey, BC — the community assignment appears to be incorrect.
Postal code discrepancy: OSM has V3R 7C1 but the website shows V3R 7Z1; address_confirmed set to false.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant with a full menu and online ordering. Useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a filling meal.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes Veggie Power Bowl (quinoa, avocado, chickpeas), Veggie Burger, and Cauliflower Wings. No explicit vegan or GF labelling found

Wi-Fi.detail: Website makes no mention of Wi-Fi

wow_evidence: family-owned American diner in Surrey... fresh ingredients
